title: Exempted from FSI / Counted in FSI / Fungible Compensatory Area

fsi_exempted.description: Areas NOT counted in FSI computation.
items: ROSLOS structures per Reg 27(1)(g)
Features in open spaces per Reg 42 (except specified sub-clauses)
Staircase rooms, lift machine rooms above top storey, lift-wells/passages in stilt, basement and floors exclusively for parking
Basement used exclusively for parking (per Reg 37)
Covered parking spaces per Reg 44(6)(a); additional parking up to 25%/50% of required parking without premium
Non-residential mechanical/automatic parking: additional 10%/20% free of FSI
One office room per Reg 37(119)
Lofts, porches, canopy per Reg 37
STP/ETP/WTP structures required by MPCB
Chajja/cornice/weather shade/sun-breaker at lintel level projecting ≤ 1.2 m
Water reservoirs/tanks (elevated or underground), electric sub-stations, pump houses, wet-waste treatment
New lift + passage in existing bldg ≤ 16m in Island City
Covered passage ≤ 1.52m from terrace lift to existing staircase
One fitness centre/yogalaya per society
Fire chutes (Reg 48(9))
Refuge areas (Reg 48(8))
Service floor ≤ 1.8 m height
Entrance lobbies in stilt, height ≤ 7.2 m or two-floor equivalent
Open-to-sky swimming pool at top terrace or top podium only
Service ducts abutting sanitary block/kitchen ≤ 1.2 m width (up to 2 m for high-rise)
Ornamental façade projection ≤ 0.30 m (or 0.60 m for non-residential)
Chimneys, elevated tanks (floor-to-tank clearance ≤ 1.5 m)
Sanitary block for domestic servants ≤ 2.2 sqm at mid-landing/stilt; ≤ 2.2 sqm per parking floor for drivers
Letter boxes, parking floors per Reg 37(3230), DG-set areas at stilt/podium
Electrical/fire duct ≤ 0.45 m width, not abutting habitable room
Electric meter room 10 sqm per 50 tenements
Refuse chute/garbage shaft
Elevation feature / dome above water tank (up to 2/6/9 m by bldg height, with ≥ 60% voids)
Rain Water Harvesting, Non-conventional Energy System
Advertisements/sky signs, ≤ 20 sqm telecom antenna on top terrace
Cooling towers/chilling plants beyond marginal open spaces or on terrace
Laundry/boiler room for hotels/hospitals/hostels
Solar-water-heater battery back-up ≤ 5 sqm in basement or terrace
Entry gate over arch
Covered parking/garage per Reg 44(6)(d)
Fire escape balcony per Reg 48(6)
Sanitary block for domestic servants beyond 31(1)(xxvi)
Part/pocket/covered terraces (except top-storey open terrace and specified exceptions)
Area below open-to-sky swimming pool with clearance > 1.5 m
AC plant room / AHU room / DG set room (except in basement)
Service floor height > 1.8 m
Balconies per Reg 37(20)
Niches below window sill
Additional telephone/PBX rooms beyond one per building
Ornamental projections and voids (except allowed under 31(1)(ii))
Excess parking floors beyond required (with paid premium)
Deck parking on habitable floors
Covered swimming pool
Excess telecom antenna area > 20 sqm on top terrace

usage_rules: Fungible on rehab component cannot be used for free-sale component
Fungible admissible to one rehab tenement cannot be transferred to another rehab tenement
Fungible must be used to give additional area over-and-above eligible area to existing tenants/occupants
Applicable only to buildings to be constructed or reconstructed

open_space_deficiency_due_to_fungible.note: Deficiency in open space created due to utilization of fungible compensatory area is condoned by charging premium at 25% of normal premium

grandfathering.prior_dcr_1991_fungible_under_reg_35_4: Continues as fungible compensatory area under Reg 31(3) — no premium demanded, refunded, or adjusted

fungible_compensatory_area.premium_utilization: Premium amount collected shall be kept in a separate account to be utilized for infrastructure development.

industry_practice_note.dcpr_text_formula: FC FSI area × ASR (land rate for FSI 1) × 60%
industry_practice_note.reconciliation: Ghatkopar SR feasibility used 50% (developer's share after MCGM=50% split, or a tentative-stage conservative rate). Live feasibility calculations may use 50% by convention; strict DCPR text says 60%. Algorithm should accept a configurable rate with 60% as default.
